title: A payroll with inheritance
description:
Build a small class hierarchy:

```csharp
public abstract class Employee(string name)       // Name; abstract decimal MonthlyPay(); virtual string Describe()
public class Salaried(string name, decimal yearlySalary) : Employee       // pay: salary / 12, rounded to cents
public class Hourly(string name, decimal rate, double hours) : Employee  // pay: rate * hours, overtime above 160 hours at 1.5 x rate
public class Commissioned(string name, decimal baseSalary, decimal sales, decimal rate) : Salaried
                                                  // pay: the Salaried pay plus sales * rate
public static class Payroll
{
    public static decimal Total(IEnumerable<Employee> staff)
    public static string Report(IEnumerable<Employee> staff)   // one Describe() line per employee, highest pay first
}
```

- All pay is rounded to cents with halves away from zero.
- `Describe()` returns `"<name>: <pay with 2 decimals>"` by default; `Hourly` overrides it to add ` (<hours> h)`, and `Commissioned` adds ` (incl. commission <commission>)`, both with invariant formatting.
- `Report` joins the lines with `\n`; ties in pay are ordered by name.
hints: `Commissioned` derives from `Salaried`, so `base.MonthlyPay()` is the salaried part; add the commission to it.
In `Hourly`, the hours up to 160 are paid at the normal rate and only the hours above 160 at 1.5 times the rate.
